source.version: Part 15 — Arthropod and Invertebrate Pests — Batch 03
source.publicationAuthorization: Project owner authorized continued website publication on 2026-09-01. Independent specialist approval remains a separate project-control field and is not implied by publication.
source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-291–295 were reconciled against peer-reviewed hemp pest reviews, current university hemp pest guidance, direct 2023 and 2026 beet-curly-top/vector research, direct Cannabis rice-root-aphid research, and bounded cross-crop slug/snail diagnostic evidence. Public wording separates injury from organism identity, vector capture from disease diagnosis, adult monitoring from damaging larval stages, and cross-crop mechanisms from Cannabis-specific thresholds.
source.note: This batch extends controlled Volume 15 with leafminers, caterpillars/bud-feeding larvae, beet leafhoppers/vectoring, root aphids/soil-dwelling pests, and slugs/snails/outdoor seedling injury.
